problem: The unqualified sh:class nltl:frame and sh:node FrameShape constraints apply to every value of the generic hasComponent path, so unrelated ship components are incorrectly required to be frames and satisfy the framing-ice-strengthening constraints.
required_change: Constrain only hasComponent values that are nltl:frame instances, using a qualified value shape or an equivalent frame-selective path while preserving validation of each applicable frame.
regression_guard: Preserve the ship-to-frame traversal without imposing frame-specific constraints on unrelated ship components.
